explication: NvChad is a Lua-based Neovim configuration, intended to be imported by a separate starter configuration. The documented user workflow is to use that starter in Neovim, which imports NvChad and its configuration modules to provide editor behavior and plugin integrations. The repository tree exposes core settings, mappings, autocmds, plugin declarations, and per-plugin configuration files. The README documents broader UI, theme, navigation, Git, language-server, completion, and syntax capabilities. No source excerpts were supplied, so edges reflect documented relationships only; several capabilities have no dedicated implementation path in this tree.
